_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate dominates: no breaker (F&G 50-62, flat funding, muted momentum) so score stays in Disbelief ±0; directional call unjustified until expansion or flush prints.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Disbelief; narrative silent on phase but inflow fade does not contradict HOLD; neither calls a rung shift
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 50-62 with funding near flat and 30d momentum still muted
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G >63 with funding/momentum expanding (Hope) or F&G <47 with VIX/gold spike and negative momentum (Complacency or lower)
